newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Big hashish haul in Dubai anti-drug drive; a total of 1,271 kg with a street value of 19 million dirhams ($5.18 million) was seized in the past five months.
- Britain reaffirms commitment to Gulf security.
- OPEC agrees to six-month quota freeze.
- Lotus plans Arabic support in future releases of Notes and Domino products, regional manager says.
- UAE stresses the need to continue Middle East peace talks.
- General Motors to sell used cars in Middle East.
- UAE and Britain call on Iran to respond to efforts to settle the dispute over Gulf islands peacefully. Iran and the UAE both claim sovereignty over the three islands.

- Banks need to employ 500 UAE nationals a year and spend 36 million dirhams on a programme to train and employ that number, bankers say. UAE officials have recommended that banks should raise the number of UAE employees by four percent a year.
